actions.description: User grasps a hanging pipette that already has a tip attached and removes it from the rack.
Moves pipette from rack toward bench area with tube racks/box.
Places/holds pipette tip into a yellow microtube/tip rack well area; appears to perform a pipetting step, but aspiration vs dispense is not visually clear.
Lifts pipette away and moves it back toward the hanging pipette rack.
Returns pipette to the rack with the same tip still attached.

reuse.evidence: The tip is used in one visible rack/well area and then returned to the rack; no second different sample/reagent use is visible.

surface.evidence: The tip is inserted/held at a yellow rack/well area, but the frames do not clearly show whether it touches a non-sterile surface versus entering a tube/well.

release.evidence: No visible dropping, unexpected ejection, or early release of the tip.

install.evidence: Tip appears attached and seated on the pipette; no visible wrong-size or loose fit issue.

output.overall_summary: A pipette with an attached tip is taken from the rack, used at a yellow rack/well area, and returned to the rack with the tip still attached. No definite error is visible; the exact pipetting step and whether the tip contacted a non-sterile surface are unclear.
